import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # Remove exact duplicate rows
    df = df.drop_duplicates()
    # Convert flipper_length_mm to numeric
    df['flipper_length_mm'] = pd.to_numeric(df['flipper_length_mm'], errors='coerce')
    # Convert body_mass_g to numeric (strip commas)
    df['body_mass_g'] = df['body_mass_g'].astype(str).str.replace(',', '')
    df['body_mass_g'] = pd.to_numeric(df['body_mass_g'], errors='coerce')
    # Convert year to numeric
    df['year'] = pd.to_numeric(df['year'], errors='coerce')
    # Normalize sex labels
    df['sex'] = df['sex'].str.lower()
    # Drop rows with invalid flipper_length_mm (out of range / negative)
    df = df[(df['flipper_length_mm'] >= 170) & (df['flipper_length_mm'] <= 235)]
    return df

def answer(df):
    result = df.groupby('species')['flipper_length_mm'].mean()
    return result.to_dict()
